protectionSection.heading: Discreet Close Protection & Secure Executive Mobility
protectionSection.lead: Uncompromising safety, absolute discretion, and seamless coordination for high-profile principals, corporate leaders, and delegations across Europe.
protectionSection.body1: At Ecram Execs, we understand that ultra-high-net-worth individuals, corporate executives, and VIP delegations require more than standard transportation: they require complete peace of mind.
protectionSection.body2: Through our strategic partnerships with elite, certified security specialists in the Netherlands and across Europe, we provide fully integrated Close Protection (CPO) and Secure Chauffeur Services. By combining our 100% electric luxury fleet with trained security drivers and close protection officers, we offer a unified, end-to-end security solution that eliminates the friction of coordinating separate transport and security providers.
protectionSection.note: Tell us about your plans and we will reply with a proposal.
protectionSection.imageAlt: An executive walking between two close protection officers along a tree-lined Amsterdam canal street, past a black Ecram Execs Mercedes-Benz

fleetSection.heading: Uncompromising Standards.
fleetSection.intro: Every vehicle in our fleet is chosen for exceptional comfort, whisper-quiet electric performance, and refined executive luxury. Combining cutting-edge electric technology with elegant, premium interiors, our top-of-the-range vehicles deliver a seamless travel experience where sophistication, comfort, and sustainability go hand in hand.
fleetSection.specNote: Every vehicle operates strictly in an all-black exterior finish with a black executive leather interior, in full top-of-the-range specification.

conciergeSection.body: Your personal concierge, available whenever you need us. From answering questions and exploring our services to guiding you through a booking, our digital concierge makes every step effortless, day or night.
conciergeSection.body2: And when your request calls for a more personal touch, you’ll be seamlessly connected with a member of our team, ensuring the attentive, discreet service that defines the Ecram Execs experience.
conciergeSection.noAnswer: I couldn't find an exact answer to that. A member of our reservations team will gladly help you personally: send us your request with the Plan Your Journey form above, or call us.
conciergeSection.faq1Q: How Far In Advance Should I Book?
conciergeSection.faq1A: We recommend booking as early as you can, particularly for airport transfers, events and busy periods. For short-notice requests, contact our reservations team and we will do everything possible to accommodate you.
conciergeSection.faq2A: If your plans change, please contact our reservations team as early as possible and we will always do our best to accommodate you.
conciergeSection.faq3Q: Can I Book For Colleagues, Clients, Or Business Partners?
conciergeSection.faq3A: Yes. You can book on behalf of colleagues, clients or business partners. Simply give us the passenger's details and any special instructions when you enquire.
conciergeSection.faq4Q: Can I Set Up A Corporate Account?
conciergeSection.faq4A: Yes. A corporate account gives your organisation a single point of contact, consolidated invoicing and dependable service for executives and guests. Get in touch and we will set it up.
conciergeSection.faq5Q: What Happens If My Flight Is Delayed Or Arrives Early?
conciergeSection.faq5A: Your chauffeur tracks your flight and adjusts the collection to your actual arrival time, so a delay or an early arrival does not disrupt your journey.
conciergeSection.faq6Q: Where Will I Meet My Chauffeur At The Airport?
conciergeSection.faq6A: Your chauffeur meets you in arrivals. We will confirm the exact meeting point with you before you travel.
conciergeSection.faq7Q: How Does Waiting Time Work, And Are There Additional Charges?
conciergeSection.faq7A: Tell us if you would like your chauffeur to wait and we will include it in the price of your journey.
conciergeSection.faq8A: Our fleet consists strictly of top-of-the-range, fully electric vehicles from leading luxury manufacturers, each finished in obsidian black with a black executive interior. See The Fleet section for the full line-up.
conciergeSection.faq9Q: Which Vehicle Best Suits My Passengers And Luggage?
conciergeSection.faq9A: Tell us how many passengers you will be travelling with and how much luggage you have, and we will recommend the most suitable vehicle.
conciergeSection.faq10A: Yes. Our fleet is 100% electric, with zero tailpipe emissions and a quieter, smoother journey.
conciergeSection.faq11Q: How Does The Electric Range Affect Longer Journeys?
conciergeSection.faq11A: Our team plans longer journeys in advance with the vehicle's electric range in mind. Share your itinerary and we will advise on the best way to travel.
conciergeSection.faq12Q: Are Your Chauffeurs Professionally Vetted And Insured?
conciergeSection.faq12A: Every chauffeur is experienced, vetted and impeccably presented, and holds the licences and insurance required for paid passenger transport in the Netherlands.
conciergeSection.faq13Q: Can I Expect Complete Discretion And Confidentiality?
conciergeSection.faq13A: Absolutely. Discretion and confidentiality are central to everything we do.
conciergeSection.faq14Q: How Do I Make A Booking?
conciergeSection.faq14A: Fill out the Plan Your Journey form on this page with your route, date and time, and choose a vehicle if you have a preference. The price is calculated as you go, and our team confirms the booking, usually within the hour. Corporate partners can also book from their own account.
conciergeSection.faq15Q: How Much Does A Journey Cost?
conciergeSection.faq15A: Every journey is priced from the rate card, based on your route, time and vehicle. Send your request via the Plan Your Journey form and the price is shown before you send it.
conciergeSection.faq16Q: How Can I Contact Your Team?
conciergeSection.faq16A: Our reservations team is available 24/7. Send your request via the Plan Your Journey form, or continue this conversation with the team via WhatsApp.
conciergeSection.fallbackScope: I can answer questions about booking and cancellations, airport transfers and flight tracking, our fully electric fleet, corporate accounts, waiting time and our chauffeurs. For anything else, our reservations team is available 24/7 via WhatsApp.
conciergeSection.fallbackBusy: Our reservations desk is available day and night. You can contact our team directly via WhatsApp.

privacy.metaDescription: How Ecram Execs collects, uses and protects your personal data.
privacy.heading: Privacy policy
privacy.s1Intro: {name} provides executive chauffeur services in the Netherlands and is the controller of the personal data described here{registered}{kvk}. Questions about this policy can be sent to
privacy.s2p1: When you request a booking we collect your name, email address, phone number, the collection point, destination (or, for an hourly booking, how many hours), date and time of your journey and of any return journey, the service and number of passengers and suitcases you select, a flight number if you give one, the name and phone number of the person travelling if you book for someone else, and any notes you add. If you send a bespoke inquiry we also collect your company or account name, the size of your delegation, your vehicle class requirements, your itinerary and special instructions, and whether you prefer to be contacted by phone or WhatsApp. We use this only to arrange your booking or programme, arrange your journey and contact you about it. The legal basis is taking steps at your request before entering into a contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR).
privacy.s2p2: When you apply to drive with us we collect your name, email address, phone number, KvK number, years of driving experience, your car's licence plate and any notes you add. We look the plate up in the public register of the RDW (the Dutch vehicle authority) to check the car against our criteria, and store the make, model, colour, seating, registration dates and taxi registration it returns. You also upload copies of your chauffeur card, KvK extract, certificate of conduct (VOG) and insurance; these are stored in a private storage area that only our team can open. We use this only to assess your application and, if it is approved, to work with you. The legal basis is taking steps at your request before entering into a contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR).
privacy.s2p3: To protect the forms against abuse we also store a one-way, salted hash of your IP address and your browser's user-agent string. The hash cannot be turned back into your IP address. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in keeping the service secure (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacy.s2p4: If you use the chat concierge on the website, the messages you type are forwarded to our AI provider (see “Who processes your data”) so it can write a reply. We save the conversation for 90 days after its last message, or for one year if the chat led to a booking that we have confirmed. It includes what you tell the concierge about your journey and the name, email address and phone number you give it, together with a one-way hash of your IP address. We use it to refer back to what was agreed, to follow up on your request, to check the quality of the replies and to deal with misuse; it is deleted sooner if the booking request it led to is deleted. Please do not put sensitive personal data in the chat. If you choose to continue via WhatsApp, the conversation is passed on to WhatsApp at your request and WhatsApp's own privacy policy applies from that moment. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in answering your questions, following up on them and keeping the service secure (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR) and, where you ask for a quotation in the chat, taking steps at your request (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR). You can ask us to delete a conversation at any time.
privacy.s3p1: The public website does not use tracking or advertising cookies. A strictly necessary session cookie is used only when our staff sign in to the internal reservations system.
privacy.s3p2: Our staff log in to an internal reservation system that uses its own session and language cookies; only staff receive these. The language choice also briefly stores your scroll position in your browser's session storage so the page stays where it was; no personal data is stored there and it disappears as soon as you close the tab.
privacy.s4p1: We use carefully selected service providers who process data on our behalf under data processing agreements:
privacy.s4Hosting: GoDaddy (Host Europe GmbH) — hosting of the website, database and uploaded documents, on a server within the European Union
privacy.s4Supabase: Supabase — database and document storage, in the European Union
privacy.s4Resend: Resend — delivery of email notifications about your request
privacy.s4Anthropic: Anthropic — the AI that writes the chat concierge's replies; it receives the messages typed into the chat
privacy.s4Google: When you type an address in the booking form, what you type is sent to Google to suggest matching places. Google receives only that text, not your name or contact details, and handles it under its own privacy policy; it may process it in the United States.
privacy.s4p3: Resend and Anthropic are located in the United States. Where personal data is transferred outside the European Economic Area, we rely on the European Commission's standard contractual clauses in our agreements with them.
privacy.s4p2: We do not sell your data or share it with third parties for marketing.
privacy.s5p1: Booking and bespoke requests are kept for up to 24 months after our last contact with you, so we can handle follow-up questions and repeat bookings. Driver applications that do not lead to a partnership, including the documents uploaded with them, are kept for up to 12 months. Conversations with the chat concierge are kept for 90 days after the last message, or for one year if they led to a confirmed booking. Information that forms part of our financial records is kept for seven years, as Dutch tax law requires. You can ask us to delete your request at any time. Deleted data can remain in our backups for up to 14 days.
privacy.s6p1: You have the right to access, correct or delete your personal data, to restrict or object to its processing, and to receive it in a portable format. Contact us at
privacy.s6p2: and we will respond within one month. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (
privacy.s7p1: Your data is transmitted over encrypted connections and stored in access-controlled systems. Only authorised staff can view booking and bespoke requests and driver applications.
privacy.s8p1: If you request access to our Corporate Partner area we collect your company email address, name and position, and the details you add to a corporate account request. We use your email address to send a one-time verification code (taking steps at your request, Article 6(1)(b) GDPR). If you tick the box on the form, we also use your details to keep you informed about our services and news by email, based on your consent (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR); you can withdraw it at any time by contacting us, and we then stop. Verification codes expire after ten minutes and are stored only in a form that cannot be read back.
privacy.s8p2: In this area you can request bookings, review bookings, send us messages and request a change or cancellation. We store the trip details you enter (collection point, destination or duration, stopovers, date and time, any return journey, number of passengers and suitcases, flight number, the person travelling if you book for someone else, vehicle and notes), your name, email address and phone number as booker, your company name and KvK number if you provided them, the price and status of the booking, and the messages and replies with it. If you submit the business introduction, we also store your company registration number, who signs on behalf of the company, a point of call, how you prefer to be contacted and which trips you expect to book. We use this to arrange your trips and reply to you (taking steps at your request and performance of our contract, Article 6(1)(b) GDPR). Our team can add invoices to a booking so you can download them; only you and our staff can open them.
privacy.s8p3: If you tick the box when creating your account, we also use your details to keep you informed about our services and news by email, based on your consent (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR). You can withdraw that consent at any time by contacting us.
privacy.s8p4: We keep your account as long as you use it. If you have not logged in for 24 months and no work has been done on any of your bookings in that time, we delete it automatically, along with the bookings that are not part of our financial records. If you start creating an account without finishing it, we delete the details after 30 days. You can also ask us at any time to close your account and delete your data; we will do so, except for what we are legally required to keep: bookings that form part of our financial records, such as invoiced bookings, remain for seven years without your personal data (only the company, route, amount and invoices remain).
